comment: files.c read_sym_file() from options.c optfn_symset() inside the chosen section. read_sym_file() (files.c:2631-2646) reads dat/symbols with parse_conf_file(), which calls free_config_sections() before and after (cfgfiles.c:1849, 1858) and so forgets both the CHOOSE choice and the current section of the configuration file being read. OPTIONS=showexp still applies because no section is current any more; [bog] and [] are then each "Section without CHOOSE" errors, and OPTIONS=time, which the choice would have skipped, applies. [fen], before the symset line, is skipped as usual. Seed, date, orcish Barbarian and section names chosen independently.
